tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: Two of the East's best — 8-2 Boston at 9-2 Philadelphia — in the Tuesday NBC primetime slot. The market can't split them: some books have Philadelphia -1.5, others Boston -1.5, and the devigged fair line is a 52.5/47.5 coin flip. No price anywhere clears our 0.75% bar, so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge, but the lean is Boston -1.5: the fair line tilts to the Celtics, and the side with the better record on the road in a coin-flip game is the one to take.
games.title: Celtics at 76ers: two of the East's best, a coin flip
games.verdict: LEAN: BOS -1.5 — no true edge, but the fair line tilts to the Celtics.

games.take: The Bucks are 1-9 and catching 15.5 at the Garden against a 5-4 Knicks team. The fair line says New York wins this nine times in ten, and the spread is the honest way to play a favorite this big — laying the moneyline pays nothing. No price clears our bar on the side, so this is a lean, not a board play. The board play in this game is the prop: Myles Turner Over 1.5 threes at -120 (BetMGM), +2.8% EV vs the devigged FanDuel fair — he takes 4.5 threes a game and shoots far better on the road. No true edge on the spread, but the lean is New York -15.5: the Bucks have lost nine of ten and the Garden is not where that turns around.
games.title: Bucks at Knicks: 1-9 Milwaukee catches 15.5 at the Garden
games.venue: Madison Square Garden, New York, NY
games.verdict: LEAN: NYK -15.5 — no true edge on the spread, but the fair line is 90% Knicks.

games.take: Phoenix is on the board tonight: -152 at BetRivers is +1.0% EV against the devigged Pinnacle fair of 61.0%, while the field is -164 to -170. The Clippers are running on fumes — Brandon Ingram still hasn't debuted after Achilles surgery, Bradley Beal is out with a knee injury, and Jordan Miller and Yanic Konan Niederhauser are out too. Booker just scored 32 on Monday, even in a 26-point loss to San Antonio where no other starter topped seven. The board also has Darius Garland Under 2.5 rebounds at -121 (DraftKings), +2.4% EV vs the devigged FanDuel fair. The lean is Phoenix: the short-handed Clippers are 2-7 for a reason.
games.title: Clippers at Suns: Phoenix is on the board at -152
games.verdict: LEAN: PHX — on the board at -152 (BetRivers), +1.0% EV vs the devigged Pinnacle fair.

games.take: The 1-9 Jazz host a 4-6 Heat team laying 9.5 on the road. Utah is in the running for the league's worst record, and the fair line has Miami winning this three times in four. But 9.5 is a lot of chalk to lay on the road for a .500 team, and no price clears our bar — the only number beating fair is an offshore Heat -312. No true edge, but the lean is Miami -9.5: the Jazz are 1-9 and the Heat are the far better team, even at this price.
games.title: Heat at Jazz: 1-9 Utah catches 9.5 at home
games.venue: Delta Center, Salt Lake City, UT
games.verdict: LEAN: MIA -9.5 — no true edge, but the Jazz are 1-9 and the fair line is 75.8% Heat.

games.matchup: Oklahoma City Thunder @ Portland Trail Blazers
games.our_fair: Thunder 54.8% / Trail Blazers 45.2% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline)
games.take: The late NBC game: 8-2 Oklahoma City at 6-3 Portland. The Blazers have been better than expected at home, and the fair line is only 54.8% Thunder — this is close to a coin flip, and the 2.5 points reflect that. No price clears our bar, so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge, but the lean is Oklahoma City -2.5: the Thunder are the better team and the defending champs' standard, and 2.5 points is a small price for the gap in class.
games.title: Thunder at Trail Blazers: the late NBC game
games.verdict: LEAN: OKC -2.5 — no true edge, but the Thunder are the better team at a small number.

games.matchup: Kent State Golden Flashes @ Bowling Green Falcons
games.our_fair: Falcons 66.2% / Golden Flashes 33.8% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline)
games.take: The MACtion opener is on the board: Bowling Green -190 at BetRivers is +1.0% EV against the devigged Pinnacle fair of 66.2%, while the field is -205 to -226. Kent State's offense is fourth-worst in FBS at 287.8 yards a game, scores touchdowns on just 39% of red-zone trips, and just turned it over five times in a 31-10 loss at Sacramento State. Bowling Green is 2-7 and hardly a world-beater, but at home against an offense this thin, the stale -190 is the value. Clear skies in Bowling Green, 51°F at kickoff, light wind — no weather factor. The lean is Bowling Green: the home favorite against the worst offense on the slate.
games.title: Kent State at Bowling Green: the MACtion opener is on the board
games.venue: Doyt L. Perry Stadium, Bowling Green, OH
games.verdict: LEAN: BGSU — on the board at -190 (BetRivers), +1.0% EV vs the devigged Pinnacle fair.
games.weather: Clear, 51°F at kickoff, wind W 4 mph — no weather factor (NWS Cleveland: no alerts)

games.take: Western Michigan comes off the bye fresh and still in the MAC title race with three weeks left, laying 14 at Akron. The fair line has the Broncos winning this 85.5% of the time, and the model gap is real — but 14 points on the road in midweek MACtion is a big number, and no price clears our bar. No true edge, but the lean is Western Michigan -14: the rested, better team with something to play for against a Zips side the market rates as a two-touchdown dog at home.
games.title: Western Michigan at Akron: Broncos off the bye, still in the title race
games.verdict: LEAN: WMU -14 — no true edge, but the rested favorite with the title race on the line.
games.weather: Clear, low 60s falling to the 40s, light wind — no weather factor

games.take: The Battle of the Bricks, the 103rd meeting, and the night's best MAC game: first-place Ohio at Miami, where the RedHawks can clinch bowl eligibility with a win. The line has flipped since the open — Miami was -1.5, now Ohio is -1.5 — and the fair line is a 51.8/48.2 coin flip, so the market has this priced about right. No price clears our bar. No true edge, but the lean is Ohio -1.5: the conference leaders, and the side the money has moved toward all week.
games.title: Ohio at Miami (OH): the Battle of the Bricks
games.verdict: LEAN: OHIO -1.5 — no true edge, but the first-place Bobcats in a coin-flip rivalry game.
games.weather: Clear, light wind — no weather factor
